svg.title: Tritone (A4/d5): information sheet
svg.desc: Tritone, A4/d5: C4 to F♯4 = G♭4, 6 semitones. A keyboard from C4 to C5 with both keys highlighted in this interval's identity colour and 6 numbered semitone hops. Two time strips show the notes one after another and together. Plogger [6] lens: Perfect-group family (straight), ↔ Both (midpoint), Neutral (Plogger), midtone dotted.

g.text: 4 letter names counted inclusively (C to F) · same key, other spelling: C4 to G♭4 is a diminished fifth
HOW TO READ THE THREE PLOGGER MARKS
perfect-group family. A family label, not a
A historic teaching lens from the archived
acoustic law. The identity colour is a separate,
Next lower: Perfect fourth (P4, 5 semitones). Root C4 stays; upper note F♯4→F4, one key
apart. Plogger: A same, B changes, C changes.
Next higher: Perfect fifth (P5, 7 semitones). Root C4 stays; upper note F♯4→G4, one key
apart. Plogger: A same, B changes, C changes.
How to read: find C4 on your keyboard, then count 6 semitones up (every key, white or
black, is one step) to F♯4. The numbered arcs are those steps. Top left shows the two
notes one after another, top right the same two notes together.
